items.name: Stone verge post
items.notes: Roadside stone marker post; counts include the _D_V1/_D_V2 variants. Plastic twin PlasticVergePost_01 (962). Cheap road-edge dressing. Not text-capable.

items.name: Stop sign
items.notes: Octagon stop sign (a separate _pole prefab is the post). Baked art, no text. Place a pair with the pole for a junction.

items.name: Give way sign
items.notes: Give-way triangle; sign and _pole are separate prefabs. Baked art only.

items.name: Priority road sign
items.notes: Priority-road diamond; _pole is the post. Baked art only. Siblings in the same folder: NoParking, OneWay, MaxSpeed30/50, JunctionMain, Refreshments, Telephone, DeadEnd, NoPeds.

items.name: Pedestrian crossing sign
items.notes: Pedestrian crossing square; pair with a pole. Baked art only. Good for a town-centre road.

items.name: Parking sign
items.notes: Blue P parking sign; _pole separate. Baked art only.

items.name: Bend ahead sign (left/right/double variants)
items.notes: Bend warning; count covers BendLeft/Right, DoubleLeft/Right and DangerCurve left/right. Rural-road dressing, baked art.

items.name: Fuel station sign
items.notes: Fuel-station roadside pictogram; only 8 on the map. Use near a petrol pump area. Baked art.

items.name: Bus stop sign
items.notes: Bus stop road sign (pole built in, no separate _pole). Has a map descriptor (SCR_MapDescriptorComponent) so it can show on the map. Pair with BusShed_E_01.

items.name: No smoking sign
items.notes: Wall/pole info plate; sibling NoSwimming, MilitaryArea, NoEntry. Baked art, no text.

items.name: Village name sign (per-town prefabs, _end = leaving side)
items.notes: Village name board; one prefab per village (Montignac, Morton, Figari, Chotain, Regina, Laruns, Vernon, Erquy, LeMoule, Villeneuf, Gravette, Levie, Durras, Tyrone, Meaux, Provins, Lamentin, EntreDeux, SaintPhilippe, SaintPierre); _end = leaving side. The name is baked into the texture, so only listed villages are available. Count covers all of them.

items.name: Direction signpost Eden set (numbered boards)
items.notes: Numbered direction signpost set (Eden_01..23, boards _1/_2/_3); destination text is baked. Count is the whole set. Harbor/Airport/PowerPlant direction signs live beside it.

items.name: Tourist arrow board (Left/Right, blue/red/green/yellow)
items.notes: Tourist arrow board (Left/Right x blue/red/green/yellow); per-site Location boards (I01..I30) carry names like SaintPhilippe, Morton, Montignac. Baked art.

items.name: Trail marker plate (rectangle/arrow/curve, 4 colours)
items.notes: Small trail marker plate (rectangle/arrow/curve in blue/red/green/yellow); no destructible component. Mostly hiking-route clutter, very common on the map.

items.name: Pub sign (V1-V3, FoodMarket variant)
items.notes: Hanging pub sign (V1-V3 plus Eden_FoodMarket_V1); baked picture. A prop, so it can be placed freely. Class on the map is not recorded; has destruction.

items.name: Shop wall sign (Grocery, CarService, GasStation, Drugstore, HouseholdWares, ClothesStore)
items.notes: Wall sign for shop fronts: GroceryStore, CarService, GasStation, Drugstore, HouseholdWares, ClothesStore (count covers all). Baked artwork, mounts flat on a facade. Siblings: SignCommercial_02_Pub_V1, SignWall3D_GroceryStore_01/Pub_02, SignRooftop_Office_E_01.

items.name: Wall plate sign (PostOffice, MunicipalOffice, ShippingCompany)
items.notes: Wall plate sign (PostOffice, MunicipalOffice, ShippingCompany sizes differ); baked text. Count covers all SignWall_01 variants.

items.name: Rooftop sign (office)
items.notes: Rooftop office sign; 6 on the map. Baked art.

items.name: Poster column
items.notes: Morris-style poster column; only 6 on the map. Poster texture baked into the model; has building-entity destruction.

items.name: Message board small (filled variants exist)
items.notes: Small message board; the _filled_V* variants come pre-pinned with paper. Count covers MessageBoard, MessageBoardSmall and Filled sets.

items.name: Map board
items.notes: Map board with a _Dot child (position marker). Baked map art.

items.name: Cork notice board
items.notes: Cork notice board (interior). LF already uses a USSR cork board with LF_SignComponent for Read cards (Feature/Signs). Count includes vanilla in houses.

items.name: A4 notice sheet (V1-V9, vertical/horizontal)
items.notes: A4 paper notice, V1-V9 vertical and horizontal (count covers all). Cheap wall clutter; LF_SignFace reuses this poster mesh for its printed-title sheet.

items.name: Single poster (RadioEveron, WashYourHands, FootballMatch, Cans, Library...)
items.notes: Single wall posters: RadioEveron, WashYourHands, FootballMatch, ProgressOfMankind, rallyeveron, Cans, Alcohol, Library, Forest. Count covers all PosterSingle prefabs.

items.name: Street lamp E_01 4m/6m (_off = unlit)
items.notes: Street lamp: child glass prefab carries a LightEntity plus StreetLampComponent (IsLightOn, SetBroken); no user action, so day/night behaviour is the engine default (not verified in play). 4m and 6m poles; _off variants (unlit) exist. Light child LV 8, pale green-white.

items.name: Street lamp E_02 (single/addon/double)
items.notes: Street lamp E_02 with single/addon/doubleAngled/doubleStraight arms; light via child glass prefab + StreetLampComponent; no switch action.

items.name: Street lamp E_03 (single/addon)
items.notes: Street lamp E_03 single/addon (+ _off variants); light child + StreetLampComponent; no switch action.

items.name: Wall light 01
items.notes: Most common prop on the map (2064). Interior wall lamp MESH only: no light entity in the prefab or parents, so it does not light a room. Add a separate light entity or use a lit variant.

items.name: Ceiling light 01
items.notes: Ceiling lamp mesh only (no light). The _on variant adds LightEntity children. Count excludes _on.

items.name: Ceiling light 03
items.notes: Ceiling lamp mesh only (no light). Needs a placed light entity to glow.

items.name: Fluorescent lamp 01
items.notes: Tube fluorescent fitting; plain prefab is mesh only. Variants: _exterior (light + StreetLampComponent) and _glass (light child). Count is the plain prefab only.

items.name: Interior lamp 01
items.notes: Interior floor/shade lamp mesh; no light component in the prefab chain.

items.name: Interior lamp 02 (colour shades)
items.notes: Interior lamp 02 in Yellow/Orange/Red shades (count covers all); mesh only, no light component.

items.name: Industrial lamp
items.notes: Industrial wall lamp; plain prefab is mesh only. _on_exterior and _on_mine variants add point+spot LightEntity. Count is LampIndustrial_01 only.

items.name: Industrial light (wall/outdoor)
items.notes: Industrial light fixture; plain mesh only. _on_exterior adds spot+point lights. Count is LightIndustrial_01 only (02 and 03 exist separately).

items.name: Kerosene lamp
items.notes: Kerosene lantern, colours green/blue/military_USSR. The only item here with a real player action: SCR_SwitchLightUserAction (light on/off), LIT_ON_SPAWN point light. Good table/stall prop.

items.name: Small power pole (scenery)
items.notes: Small power pole; counts 1304. SCR_PowerPole class (cable slots), scenery only.

items.name: Street bench 02
items.notes: Street bench, no ActionsManager in vanilla. LF provides an invisible sit place Prefabs/Props/Seats/LF_Seat_BenchStreet_02.et (F to Sit) to place over it.

items.name: Street bench 01 (green/red/yellow_red)
items.notes: Street bench 01 in green, red and yellow_red (count covers all). No vanilla sit action; LF has LF_Seat_BenchStreet_01_green.et and _red.et seat anchors.

items.name: Wooden bench 01
items.notes: Wooden park bench; no sit action; no LF seat anchor yet.

items.name: Wooden bench 03
items.notes: Wooden bench 03; no sit action; no LF seat anchor yet.

items.name: Church pew (short/long)
items.notes: Church pew (short and long, count covers both); no sit action; wide 4-5 person run.

items.name: Office/waiting bench
items.notes: Waiting-room / office bench (also _Green); no sit action. Good for station, clinic, or bank lobby.

items.name: Picnic table with benches
items.notes: Picnic table with attached benches; no sit action. Good for beach/park dressing.

items.name: Street bin
items.notes: Street litter bin; has TagComponent; destructible. No interact action.

items.name: Trash bin 02
items.notes: Plastic wheeled trash bin; no interact action. Common behind houses and shops.

items.name: Garbage container (with lid)
items.notes: Large lidded dumpster (lid is a separate prefab, 206); TagComponent; no interact action. Back alleys.

items.name: Street ashtray post
items.notes: Standing street ashtray; 90 on the map; no action. Count excludes the tabletop Ashtray_01 family.

items.name: Mailbox
items.notes: Post mailbox, 19 on the map, none inside the four town dumps. Static, no deposit action.

items.name: Phone booth (lit variant _Light)
items.notes: Glass phone booth with a door action (SCR_DoorUserAction) and a _Light child (LightEntity). Glass panes are child prefabs. A prop only; it is not a working phone.

items.name: Wall payphone
items.notes: Wall payphone prop; no action; mesh only.

items.name: Street fire hydrant
items.notes: Street fire hydrant, destructible, 24 on the map.

items.name: Bus shelter (blue/green)
items.notes: Bus shelter (blue/green); no seat action, destructible building entity. Pair with SignBusStop_01. Count covers both colours.

items.name: Newspaper kiosk (redyellow/redwhite)
items.notes: Newspaper kiosk (redyellow/redwhite). Has a door action (SCR_DoorUserAction); a stall front for roleplay vendor use.

items.name: Newspaper stand
items.notes: Newspaper stand; no action; 46 on the map.

items.name: Market stall (umbrella variant)
items.notes: Market stall (MarketStand_01_Umbrella variant 73); no action. Count covers both. A shop-front-in-the-street prop.

items.name: Wooden pole fence 01 (3m/6m)
items.notes: Most placed fence on the map (3m/6m segments, count excludes pole/end pieces). Rural wooden pole fence.

items.name: Wire net fence 02 (2/4/8m)
items.notes: Wire mesh fence in 2/4/8m pieces; has navmesh-blocking and explosion points.

items.name: Wooden fence 01 (2/4/8m)
items.notes: Wooden plank fence (2/4/8m); NavmeshCustomLink for AI.

items.name: Guardrail (4m/8m, V1/V2)
items.notes: Road guardrail (4m/8m, V1/V2); Start/End caps separate.

items.name: Bar gate (boom barrier)
items.notes: Boom barrier gate; SCR_DoorUserAction found in the prefab chain (raise/lower). StaticModelEntity. Good for car park or yard entry.

items.name: Traffic cone (red; stack variant)
items.notes: Traffic cone (red); a _stack variant exists (31). No action. Count includes the _stack variant.

items.name: Road block
items.notes: Road block barrier, destructible; 30 on the map.

items.name: Sea bollard (harbour)
items.notes: Harbour mooring bollard (418); asset_search for bollard finds only this one, so there is no street bollard in vanilla.

items.name: Concrete kerb 2m
items.notes: Concrete kerb piece 2m (many variants); no destruction. Highest-count street piece (4453); builds pavement edges.

items.name: Asphalt pavement strip (narrow/wide 4m)
items.notes: Asphalt pavement strip, Narrow/Wide 4m variants (count covers both A pieces); no destruction.

items.name: Wall flag holder
items.notes: Wall flag bracket (54 on the map, mesh only). Pair with a Flag_* prefab for an actual flag.

items.name: Flag pole (no flag)
items.notes: Flagpole with no flag, 13 on the map (military base style); add a Flag_* prefab. Mesh only.

items.name: Fountain
items.notes: Town fountain; map-descriptor component; only 3 on the map (Montignac, Morton area). Destructible.

items.name: Plague column monument
items.notes: Plague-column monument; 5 on the map; fractal destruction.

items.name: Soldier statue
items.notes: Soldier statue; only 4 on the map; destructible.

items.name: Street planter box (rect/octa, flowers by colour)
items.notes: Street planter box (rect long/short, octa; begonia and tagetes colours; count covers all). Common in Saint Philippe/Pierre.

items.name: Pelargonia flowerpot (colours)
items.notes: Window/doorstep flowerpot (red, pink, white, V2 variants; count covers all). Very common town dressing.

items.name: Ceiling light 01 lit variant (emits light)
items.notes: Lit variant of LightCeiling_01 with LightEntity pair; used by LF in the drug store polish. Not placed by vanilla Everon (0 in world dump).

items.name: Fluorescent lamp exterior (lit variant)
items.notes: Exterior fluorescent with LightEntity + StreetLampComponent. Small count.

items.name: Industrial lamp lit exterior variant
items.notes: Lit exterior variant (point + spot lights, StreetLampComponent). Not placed in vanilla Everon world dump.

items.name: Industrial light lit exterior variant
items.notes: Lit exterior variant (spot + point lights, StreetLampComponent). Not placed in vanilla Everon world dump.

items.name: Saint Philippe village name sign
items.notes: Village sign with the Saint Philippe name baked in; _end is the exit side. Verified present at world positions.

items.name: Saint Pierre village name sign
items.notes: Village sign with the Saint Pierre name baked in; _end is the exit side.

items.name: Flag 1:2 (Everon; also Blue, Green, Red, RedCross, SovietArmy, USArmy, USSR, US, White) and 2:3 sets
items.notes: Placeable cloth flag prefabs exist (1:2 and 2:3 ratios; Everon, Blue, Green, Red, RedCross, SovietArmy, USArmy, USSR, US, White) but none is placed in the vanilla Everon world dump. Mesh/cloth only, no destruction found.
